deliberate_adaptations: use the same fresh PLIP/CLIP ViT-B/32 backbone as the other standardized SSL methods
global resolution 256 instead of the generic DINOv3 default 224 to match the shared backbone and benchmark
keep local resolution 96, using CLIP's built-in bicubic positional interpolation for the 3x3 patch grid
retain CLIP/PLIP input normalization inside the shared backbone instead of DINOv3 ImageNet normalization
use the shared benchmark mean final patch-token downstream readout
omit Gram anchoring because this experiment evaluates the DINOv3 base pretraining objective, before the separate Gram-anchoring stage
tune the actual single-GPU peak LR directly under the benchmark instead of applying DINOv3's distributed sqrt_wrt_1024 LR scaling rule
express the source 10/100 LR warmup and 30/100 teacher-temperature warmup as 0.10 and 0.30 fractions so the same schedules scale consistently in 20-epoch tuning and 300-epoch training
use a single-GPU AdamW parameter grouping without DINOv3's native layerwise LR decay or patch-embedding LR multiplier because those controls are tied to the native DINOv3 ViT optimization recipe
source_metadata.source_objective: DINO self-distillation + iBOT masked-patch prediction + KoLeo regularization
